title: taxi
summary: The flight-master wire covers exact status query/reply, gated SMSG_SHOWTAXINODES (including the valid four-byte zero-gate body and fixed u32[8] mask), direct CMSG_ACTIVATETAXI, full guid/cost/count/node-chain CMSG_ACTIVATETAXIEXPRESS, exact activate reply with stock error routing, and empty-body SMSG_NEW_TAXI_PATH with its yellow discovery message and TaxiNodeDiscovered kit.

openItems.text: CMSG_ACTIVATETAXIEXPRESS never sent - MSUI always sends single-hop CMSG_ACTIVATETAXI from the current node, so a destination with no direct TaxiPath edge current->target (Benilla's byte-verified discriminator) cannot be flown
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: TaxiPath edge presence now selects direct CMSG_ACTIVATETAXI versus CMSG_ACTIVATETAXIEXPRESS; the express body carries full guid, shown total fare, node count, and the complete resolved chain.

openItems.text: SMSG_NEW_TAXI_PATH has no handler - the never-visited-node first-contact learn pair is dropped on the floor
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: opcode 0x01AF is dispatched as an exact empty body and produces the reference yellow discovery message plus TaxiNodeDiscovered sound kit.

openItems.text: ApplyTaxiNodes rejects bodies under 20 bytes, so the gated-off 4-byte SMSG_SHOWTAXINODES form (leading gate word 0) throws instead of parsing to a no-op as Benilla does (never sent by vmangos, low impact)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: TaxiPackets.ParseShowNodes implements the u32 conditional gate and accepts the exact four-byte zero form while enforcing eight mask words for a nonzero gate.
